text.en:
The title of Executive Order No. 754 is hereby amended as
IA Halogram « 56034
"REVISING THE EXPANDED DELINEATED LEGAZPI
PORT ZONE AS PROVIDED FOR UNDER EXECUTIVE ORDER
NO. 347, SERIES OF 1996 AS AMENDED BY EXECUTIVE
ORDER NO. 166, SERIES OF 1999"

Section 1 of Executive Order No. 754, Series of 2008 is
hereby corrected as follows:
"Section 1. The territorial jurisdiction of the Port of Legazpi is
hereby further revised and delineated as follows:
Beginning at the point marked on the plan at a distance of
405.42 m., with bearing S 46 deg: 13' E from BI.LM No. 1 Cad. 47,
Albay Cadastre to corner 1; thence to point 2 at a distance of
168.32 m., with bearing N 82 deg. 12' E; thence to point 3 at a
distance of 372.05 m., with bearing N 22 deg. 23' W; thence to
# 558034

point 4 at a distance 425.04 m., with bearing N 10 deg. 51' W;
thence to point 5 at a distance of 299.60 m., with bearing N 02
deg. 17' E; thence to point 6 at a distance of 332.50 m., with
bearing N 17 deg. 36' E; thence to point 7 at a distance of 950.00
m., with bearing due East; thence to point 8 at a distance of
1,600.40 m., with bearing due South; thence to point 9 at a
distance of 444.59 m., with bearing S 89 deg. 51' W; thence to
point 10 at a distance of 109.45 m., with bearing N 34 deg. 00' W;
thence to point 11 at a distance of 308.56 m., with bearing S 54
deg. 04' W; thence to point 12 at a distance of 235.65 m., with
bearing N 62 deg. 00' W; thence to point 13 at a distance of 61.12
m., with bearing N 27 deg. 43' W; thence to point 1 at a distance
of 127.54 m., with bearing N 06 deg. 57' W, all in all comprising a
total area of 1,598,074.90 sq. m., more or less."
SECTION 2. All executive issuances or portions thereof which are
inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby revoked, amended or modified
accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 16th day of March, in the year of Our
Lord, Two Thousand and Ten.
By the President:
LEANDROR. MÉNDOZA
Executive Secretary
PGMA Hologram 56035
